item.title: Portwell Releases PCOM-B887 AI-Ready COM-HPC Module
item.summary: Portwell has launched the PCOM-B887, an AI-ready COM-HPC module built around Intel Core Ultra 200S Series processors for high-performance embedded and edge computing. The COM-HPC Client Type Size C module combines CPU, GPU and dedicated NPU resources with high-speed interfaces and expandable memory.
